Welcome to BubbleBuilder! 🫧

An original browser-based, Yeeps-style creative playground using selected GLB models from your uploaded ZIP. No internet, account or installation needed.

📱 Touch / iPad

WalkUse the left thumbstick.
LookDrag across the world with your right finger.
Build by handTap the 3D inventory bubble, pick a model, then aim and tap PLACE (or tap the ground).
Jump / EraseUse the JUMP and ERASE buttons.
RotateTap ROTATE to turn a model 90°.

⌨️ Desktop

Walk / JumpW A S D · SPACE · hold Shift to run.
LookClick the world to lock mouse, then move to look. ESC releases it.
BuildLeft click or E to place · X to remove · R to rotate · Q for bubbles · Z to undo.

💾 Your creations

Builds autosave on this device. Use SAVE to download a .json world file; LOAD imports it again. This version is single-player creative mode.
